global_rules.no_false_precision: Initial values are engineering test points, not verified market constants.
global_rules.three_point_minimum: Every active parameter must be tested at low, base and high values or have an explicit nonnumeric boundary test.
global_rules.narrow_dependence: A conclusion that survives only a narrow parameter neighborhood is unstable.
global_rules.holdout: No parameter may be changed after a one-time holdout is opened.
global_rules.real_risk: No value in this registry authorizes a real account, position size or monetary risk.

parameters.reality_meaning: Closed bars required to treat a structural break or reclaim as accepted.
parameters.basis: Tests one-bar noise versus excessive delay.
parameters.update_condition: Only from DEVELOPMENT/CALIBRATION with fixed labels.

parameters.reality_meaning: Maximum substantive paths competing in one decision window, excluding UNKNOWN.
parameters.basis: One leading, two alternatives and one tail path.
parameters.update_condition: Change only with a new finite-path library version.

parameters.reality_meaning: Past-only neighbors used for an analog distribution.
parameters.basis: Balances local relevance and sampling variance.
parameters.update_condition: After D3 support analysis; never on holdout.

parameters.reality_meaning: Strength pulling a local analog proportion toward its state base rate.
parameters.basis: Prevents small-neighbor false certainty.
parameters.update_condition: Estimate on calibration only after analog model is authorized.

parameters.reality_meaning: Minimum separation after a validation sample before nearby training samples are eligible.
parameters.basis: Reduces overlap leakage.

parameters.reality_meaning: Maximum variable-duration episode length before expiry.
parameters.basis: Permits variable paths while forcing expiry.

parameters.reality_meaning: Upper ER boundary for a balance candidate.
parameters.basis: Candidate engineering range from low directional efficiency.
parameters.update_condition: Per instrument/timeframe calibration with a simpler baseline.

parameters.reality_meaning: Lower ER boundary for a directional impulse candidate.
parameters.basis: Candidate engineering range from high directional efficiency.

parameters.reality_meaning: Lookback used by direction efficiency.
parameters.basis: Tests short response versus smoother context.

parameters.reality_meaning: Duration for measuring post-event tail risk and persistence.
parameters.basis: Covers immediate and same-day reactions.
parameters.update_condition: Event-class development only after PIT clocks qualify.

parameters.reality_meaning: Post-event window used to form an event VWAP reference.
parameters.basis: Tests immediate versus extended acceptance.

parameters.reality_meaning: Frozen within-dependency-group aggregation rule.
parameters.extreme_bounds: Any alternative requires a new versioned aggregator contract and development-only comparison
parameters.basis: Prevents correlated observations from being counted as independent while keeping deterministic tie handling.
parameters.update_condition: Only by a new theory and contract version before chronology freeze.

parameters.reality_meaning: Maximum ordinal contribution from one dependency group per update.
parameters.basis: Matches the candidate -2 to +2 ordinal scale without multiple counting.

parameters.reality_meaning: Symmetric absolute bound Q on an accumulated E0 ordinal path score.
parameters.basis: Keeps the qualitative ledger bounded without representing probability.
parameters.update_condition: Development-only comparison before any calibration or holdout freeze.

parameters.reality_meaning: Time over which an evidence item's contribution halves absent invalidation.
parameters.basis: Candidate decay neighborhood; structure and trigger evidence require separate profiles.
parameters.update_condition: Per evidence class using calibration only.

parameters.reality_meaning: Conditional probability that an exact order plan fills.
parameters.basis: Cannot be estimated from candles or assumed from order submission.

parameters.reality_meaning: Past-only funding percentile treated as an extreme crowding candidate.
parameters.basis: Tests broad versus rare extreme definitions.

parameters.reality_meaning: Decision-to-venue and venue-to-observation latency profile.
parameters.basis: Requires target environment measurements.

parameters.reality_meaning: Past window for OI, funding, basis and forced-flow changes.
parameters.basis: Tests intraday versus multi-day crowding context.

parameters.reality_meaning: Minimum modeled net advantage above a comparator before action is considered.
parameters.basis: Boundary test only before calibrated EV exists.
parameters.update_condition: Calibration only; no real monetary risk.

parameters.reality_meaning: Maximum bars a path remains active without its registered resolution.
parameters.basis: Prevents permanent narratives.

parameters.reality_meaning: Allowed timing or value tolerance when matching a partial-order path step.
parameters.unit: ATR or one role-bar equivalent by field
parameters.basis: Tests strict versus flexible matching.

parameters.reality_meaning: Conservative delay added when source publication availability is coarser than decision time.
parameters.initial_value: 0 when exact; one source interval when coarse
parameters.basis: Fails conservatively when precise intraday clocks are absent.
parameters.update_condition: Replace only with authoritative clock evidence.

parameters.reality_meaning: Window ending at the cutoff for measuring trade/order pressure and immediate impact.
parameters.basis: Tests micro shock duration without overlap with response.

parameters.reality_meaning: History excluded around a validation sample to prevent overlapping-label leakage.
parameters.basis: Matches the overlap risk of the target label.

parameters.reality_meaning: Extra modeled value required to continue rather than exit an open position.
parameters.basis: Covers uncertainty and switching costs in candidate management.
parameters.update_condition: Same-entry calibration only; cannot use seen trade outcome.

parameters.reality_meaning: Minimum normalized recovery/replenishment for a resilience candidate.
parameters.basis: Broad boundary test until strict data allow estimation.

parameters.reality_meaning: Non-overlapping post-pressure window for resilience.
parameters.basis: Separates immediate impact from recovery.

parameters.reality_meaning: Past-only upper RSI percentile candidate.
parameters.basis: Tests relative extremes rather than fixed 70.

parameters.reality_meaning: Past-only lower RSI percentile candidate.
parameters.basis: Tests relative extremes rather than fixed 30.

parameters.reality_meaning: RSI calculation lookback.
parameters.basis: Common engineering starting range, not a validated optimum.

parameters.reality_meaning: Past median-volume lookback for RVOL.
parameters.basis: Tests recent versus stable participation baseline.

parameters.reality_meaning: Minimum shock range or displacement normalized by ATR.
parameters.basis: Defines a material but testable shock neighborhood.

parameters.reality_meaning: Execution-price degradation relative to a frozen reference.
parameters.basis: Requires exact venue, order and size measurements.

parameters.reality_meaning: Difference between state entry and exit evidence thresholds.
parameters.basis: Tests noise reduction against state delay.
parameters.update_condition: State development only with no-hysteresis comparator.

parameters.reality_meaning: Volatility buffer beyond structural invalidation.
parameters.basis: Separates exact structure from noise buffer.

parameters.reality_meaning: ATR reversal required to confirm an adaptive swing.
parameters.basis: Candidate range for volatility-adaptive swings.

parameters.reality_meaning: Maximum holding duration without thesis resolution.
parameters.basis: Binds action to its hypothesis window.

parameters.reality_meaning: ATR component of zone half-width.
parameters.basis: Candidate volatility-scaled zone neighborhood.

parameters.reality_meaning: Upper normalized boundary of the candidate middle no-edge region.
parameters.basis: Pairs with lower middle boundary; candidate veto only.

parameters.reality_meaning: Lower normalized boundary of the candidate middle no-edge region.
parameters.basis: Pairs with upper middle boundary; candidate veto only.

parameters.reality_meaning: Price-proportional minimum zone half-width.
parameters.basis: Guards against an unrealistically thin zone at low ATR.

parameters.reality_meaning: Window used to measure a zone touch reaction before the next touch.
parameters.basis: Tests short and extended reaction quality.
